title: Teams that will SHAPE THE DRAFT: Contenders 'one good draft' away from a Super Bowl title

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Teams that will SHAPE THE DRAFT: Contenders 'one good draft' away from a Super Bowl title
sources.description: Matt Harmon and Scott Pianowski continue our 'Teams that will shape the draft' series by looking at the true contenders that are 'one good draft' away from winning a Super Bowl title. In this deep dive, Harmon and Pianowski check in on the Rams, Seahawks, Bills, 49ers, Chargers, Eagles and Lions and what their plans could be entering the draft.
